instance_description:
Setting: In 2026, a Seattle recreational dragon boat club practices on Lake Union and attends amateur regional regattas, with shared boats, paddles, dock routines, and team communications.
Scope: Covers one paddler’s recurring hobby life: water practices, dryland conditioning, regatta preparation, equipment care, carpools, volunteer shifts, safety paperwork, and personal hobby spending.
Resources: Empty SQLite tables can hold reusable paddler profile, gear-care, and commitment records; blank text files support later logs, race packets, and boat-care notes; one personal wallet starts at zero.
Exclusions: Excludes paid coaching, youth supervision, club governance, medical advice, official race timing, facility management, unrelated social events, and scenario-specific facts.
personal_description:
Identity: Elian Sorrel Whitby is an adult recreational dragon boat paddler in Seattle, Washington, active with the Rainwake Paddling Collective throughout 2026.
Responsibilities: He tracks his own practices, conditioning plans, race availability, packing lists, dues reminders, shared-gear observations, and volunteer commitments around amateur paddling.
Authority: Elian may manage his personal hobby records, payments, reminders, files, and messages to teammates, but he cannot change official club rosters, safety policies, or regatta rules.
Restrictions: He avoids storing teammates’ sensitive personal data, acting as a certified coach, giving medical or rescue advice, committing club funds, or using these resources outside paddling hobbies.
